passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: The sea is blue and wide.
A wave comes to the sand, and I pick up a shell.
phrases.ko: 파도가 모래 위로 오고, 나는 조개를 주워요.

phrases.en: I see a small boat on the water.
phrases.ko: 나는 물 위에 있는 작은 배를 봐요.

phrases.en: The wind is cool, and I want to swim.
I love the sea because it makes me calm.
phrases.ko: 바다는 나를 차분하게 해서 나는 바다를 사랑해요.

phrases.en: My family goes to the sea in summer.
My little sister looks for a pretty shell.
The wide sea meets the blue sky.
We do not swim when the wave is too high.
phrases.ko: 파도가 너무 높으면 우리는 수영하지 않아요.

phrases.en: The wind lifts my hair, and I laugh.
phrases.ko: 바람이 내 머리를 들어 올리고, 나는 웃어요.

phrases.en: I love a quiet hour by the sea.
phrases.ko: 나는 바다 옆의 조용한 시간을 좋아해요.

full_passage_spoken: The sea is blue and wide. A wave comes to the sand, and I pick up a shell. I see a small boat on the water. The wind is cool, and I want to swim. I love the sea because it makes me calm. My family goes to the sea in summer. My little sister looks for a pretty shell. The wide sea meets the blue sky. We do not swim when the wave is too high. The wind lifts my hair, and I laugh. I love a quiet hour by the sea.
